platform_findings.activation: Accessory-policy apps cannot be activated by synthetic events on macOS 26 (injected keys/clicks/hotkeys do not count as user gestures). NSApp.activate + activateIgnoringOtherApps only take effect under a real user-initiated context, or when run with regular activation policy (MASCOT_REGULAR_APP=1 test flag proves the path).
platform_findings.ime: Input-method sources (Kotoeri) cannot be selected programmatically: TISSelectInputSource -> paramErr(-50); NSTextInputContext.setSelectedKeyboardInputSource silently ignores input-method IDs. System input menu / real user gesture required. Composition pipeline verified via the same NSTextInputClient entry points the IME calls (setMarkedText/insertText/unmarkText through ime_mark/ime_insert/ime_discard control commands).
platform_findings.hide_during_composition: Resigning key commits preedit natively on macOS (NSTextView semantics); committed state remains consistent.
platform_findings.linker: Default CommandLineTools SDK 27 .tbd files contain arm64e.x1-* entries the linker rejects; all builds pin SDKROOT=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.sdk.
